factBoundaries.evidence: Table II: 25.5 vs 21.9. Relative gain from rounded table values is 16.438356%; abstract says 17%, main text says 16%.
14 semantic classes plus empty. First main run has no fixed seed and is best W-mIoU of three. Three-run means: 23.83±2.15 vs 20.93±0.90. Merged vehicle: 2.6 vs 6.5.
factBoundaries.decision: Keep class balance, first-run status and vehicle regression adjacent to results; EBKL is not weather accuracy.

factBoundaries.evidence: Author footnote says submitted to IEEE. Lab entry currently names Sensors Journal with a different title; search cache named TVT preparation.
Appendix F.1: 1,831 pedestrian and 2,520 static-obstacle training frames; additional RGB, LiDAR and radar; original expert frozen.
factBoundaries.decision: No zero-training or unchanged-sensor claim. Detector contribution was not separately isolated.

factBoundaries.evidence: Table 3: SR 74.0→83.4 while collisions 0.050→0.145. Table 4: budget-matched SR 77.3→83.4 while collisions 0.125→0.145.
factBoundaries.decision: No blanket safety improvement over conservative fallback.

factBoundaries.evidence: Appendix B.2: synchronous recovery pauses CARLA. Opus standalone median 4.69 s. Route profiling uses Qwen: 9.88→11.44 min with a 180 s simulation budget.
factBoundaries.decision: Separate API latency, simulation time and wall-clock time; no 20 Hz wall-clock claim.

factBoundaries.evidence: Official repository tree bb144a8e6fa6b6980f9589e7c1df6c45b7f6ad66 contains implementation, configuration, LFS pointers and SHA256SUMS. One pedestrian detector object returned HTTP 206 and 160 actual model bytes in a bounded probe.
